Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-latency-p90-service-A exceeded 1200ms (rate: 8/min). Auto-page to oncall.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Alert #INC-8271 -> triggered, routed to team: eng-oncall.
Alex: seeing the page. jumping in — checking dashboards.
Jamie: I can take if Alex needs handoff, oncall til 12:30.
Incident Bot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 2m if not acked.
Alex: acking now. digging into per-route latency, looks like 3x increase on /v1/generate for model: redwood-xl-1.
Sam: throwing a quick top-level check: any ongoing deploys? CI deploy bot shows no deploy in last 30m.
Alex: no deploys. checking GPU pool metrics and queue lengths.
Alex: noticed small burst of queued requests on pool-dedicated-1, avg kv-cache miss % bumped.
Morgan: could be KV warmup noise. we've seen this pattern when a spot of warmups happen across hosts.
Jamie: any customer-facing errors? SLO panel shows error rate normal, only latency spike.
Alex: no 5xx. customers OK-ish. but some user chats reported lag.
Sam: running quick mitigation — temporarily increase pool size by +2 replicas for pool-dedicated-1.
Alex: executed scaling command:
```
infractl scale pool --name pool-dedicated-1 --delta 2
```
Incident Bot: action recorded: infractl scale by Sam at 3199999999. +2 replicas requested.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by Alex.
Alex: scaled hosts are provisioning; KV-cache warmup should intensify but queue drains faster.
Jamie: good call. I'll monitor latency traces.
Alex: latency p90 dropping back to baseline in the last 40s. p95 still a hair elevated.
Morgan: looks like transient warmup + a small inbound burst, no config bug.
Sam: infra autoscaler note: short-lived spike, we might tune cooldown to avoid flapping.
Alex: agree — follow-up: add a short cooldown + safety to avoid repeatedly scaling on warmups.
Jamie: capturing action item: tune autoscaler cooldown and add a metric for prefix-KV warmup noise. I'll create a ticket.
Alex: marking incident as resolved — no customer-impacting errors; brief user-perceived lag for <2m. closing in PD.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: INC-8271 -> resolved by Alex at 3200000130.
Incident Bot: Thread auto-archive in 24h. :white_check_mark:
